control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of HT-9005

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9005 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9005 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 12 May 2004 a near hit was recorded on HT-9005 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
